2026: data quality and declared universe liquidity screening only; no strategy evaluation
signal_combinations: all ten singles plus all45 unordered distinct pairs combined with logical AND

fixed.entry: next session open after completed daily/weekly signal
fixed.idle_cash: official French daily RF applied to prior-close cash; financing proxy, not actual broker yield
fixed.aggregation: 500 equal initial independent sleeves; no cross-stock rebalancing or shared capital

events.daily_signals: single signals only, plus unconditional controls
events.baseline: same signal-date eligible stock pool and same-condition stock pool forward net returns
events.interpretation: overlapping event descriptions, not independent trades, portfolio returns or causal evidence

selection.information: train2022-2023 only; save selected IDs and train hash before validation
selection.balanced_score: mean annualized RF-excess return / max(maximum drawdown,0.01)
selection.high_win: maximum net closed-trade win rate among eligible candidates with positive annualized RF-excess mean and profit factor>1; otherwise none
selection.high_return: highest total return among eligible candidates; label diagnostic if excess<=0
selection.ties: higher profit factor, then stable candidate ID

statistics.scope: full1540 candidate family synchronized circular-date blocks; centered max-mean family and adjusted candidate tests, Holm; selected CI
statistics.hypothesis: positive mean return above daily RF, not factor alpha; selected IID DSR only auxiliary

limitations: 2022-2025 history has already been viewed. Chronological validation is retrospective, not an untouched holdout.
Current IWB membership and2026 endpoint price/liquidity screening create survivor and future-universe selection bias.
The original100 retain their earlier retrieval vintage; new400 have a later Yahoo snapshot. Every file retains actual timestamps and hashes.
Daily-only long-side research; no short selling, pyramiding, shared portfolio allocation or actual order-book simulation.
Representative public indicator families, not every market strategy or a verbatim original Turtle/Elder system.
Yahoo vendor OHLC may already be split adjusted; the10USD historical screen is a vendor-series research threshold, not a reconstructed exchange nominal price.
Early exit changing win rate alone does not prove signal decay; compare horizon returns, payoff ratio, costs, and matched controls.
Higher single-signal win rates cannot be multiplied as independent probabilities; correlated signal combinations must be evaluated jointly.
The finite family has1540 registered cases;72 previous cases make at least1612 lifetime trials, excluding unenumerated earlier exploratory work.
